en.headline: HKDI opens Leslie Cheung memorial exhibition with rarely seen photographs
en.dek: The free show at Hong Kong Design Institute runs until 15 November and features previously unpublished images from the 1980s and 1990s by local and Korean photographers.
body: Hong Kong Design Institute has opened a free memorial exhibition dedicated to the late singer and actor Leslie Cheung, marking the 70th anniversary of his birth. Organised with the Hong Kong Institute of Professional Photographers, the display runs until 15 November at the institute in Tseung Kwan O.

The main section presents rarely seen Polaroids, film negatives and prints taken in the 1980s and 1990s by Hong Kong photographers Fanco Lai, Jonny Koo, Lewis Ho and Sam Wong, as well as Korean photographer Hyung S. Kim. Many of the images are being shown publicly for the first time.

Visitors can also experience immersive interactive zones that recreate traditional darkroom processes and view a classic microphone stand from Cheung’s Final Encounter of the Legend concert. The institute has collaborated with Universal Music to produce a limited edition of 500 memorial vinyl records designed with student involvement.
The exhibition is open daily from 10 am to 7 pm at 3 King Ling Road, Tseung Kwan O. Admission is free.

zh.headline: 知專辦張國榮紀念展 首度公開八九十年代珍藏照片
zh.dek: 「風華70・設計共鳴 哥哥紀念展」即日至11月15日於將軍澳香港知專設計學院免費開放，展出本地及韓國攝影師珍藏影像。
body: 香港知專設計學院與香港專業攝影師公會合辦「風華70・設計共鳴 哥哥紀念展」，即日起至11月15日於將軍澳院校免費開放，紀念張國榮誕辰70周年。
主展區展出香港攝影師賴家興、辜滄石、何小黑、黃永熹及韓國攝影師金亨宣於八、九十年代拍攝的即影即有、底片及印相作品，大部分首次公展。
展覽設有沉浸式互動體驗，包括仿製黑房曬相場景，以及張國榮《告別樂壇演唱會》經典麥克風咪座。知專更與環球唱片合作推出限量500張紀念黑膠唱片，學生參與封套設計。
展覽開放時間為每日上午10時至晚上7時，地點為將軍澳景嶺路3號香港知專設計學院，免費入場。
